title: Untitled: SIR HENRY SIDNEY was the brave…
text: SIR HENRY SIDNEY was the brave and virtuous father of the more renowned Sir Philip. To a friend of a fretful and quarrelsome temper, he said, "Take it from me, a weak man complains of others, an unfortunate man of himself: but a wise man complains neither of others nor of himself."
